title: Cross-Modal Collaboration with Side Temporal Adaptation for Open-Vocabulary Temporal Action Localization
hypothesis: A cross-modal collaboration framework that combines a frozen vision-language model with Side Temporal Adaptation and classification ensemble can improve temporal action localization across both seen and unseen action categories while preserving the VLM's zero-shot generalization capability.
research_questions: How effectively does Side Temporal Adaptation improve temporal modeling and localization of human actions when using a frozen image-pretrained vision-language model?
How does the proposed classification ensemble strategy affect performance on seen and unseen action categories?
How does the proposed framework perform under different open-vocabulary settings on THUMOS'14 and ActivityNet-1.3?
How do different knowledge transfer approaches and VLM backbones affect open-vocabulary temporal action localization performance?
